results.title: Laos Detains 41 in Raids on Suspected Scam, Gambling Operations
results.content: Lao authorities detained 41 people during three separate raids on rented homes in Vientiane Capital in early November. Police investigated suspected cybercrime and online gambling operations, according to local media reports.
